integrity: All mathematical claims are limited to the stated model and regime; symbolic verification and numerical reconstruction are not treated as proofs of infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Only prevalence-driven SIRCm equilibrium statements at strict supercriticality; no stability or transmission-driven uniqueness claim. Exact symbolic identities and a reproducible finite example support an analytic all-parameter proof. Comparisons with some older full-text sources were incomplete; unindexed duplication remains possible. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Global two-channel endemic uniqueness and asymmetric immune-escape limits in the prevalence-driven SIRCm system
